meta.name: antinet-security-scan
meta.description: 对进入系统的文件或 URL 执行安全与合规扫描，输出 pass/reject 判定与扫描报告，作为所有文档处理的强制前置关卡。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描文件和链接，给出安全合规的放行或拒绝结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你需要在上传文件或打开链接之前，先确认它们没有安全问题。
copy.tagline_en: Scan files and links, then issue pass/reject security report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to vet files or links for safety before they enter your system.

howto.what: 对进入系统的文件或 URL 执行安全与合规扫描，输出 pass/reject 判定和扫描报告，并写入追踪记录；作为所有文档处理的第一道强制检查关卡。
howto.when: 当有文件或 URL 被送入系统时自动作为第一道闸门触发；若扫描服务不可用，会拒绝文件并告警，绝不放行。

say.text: 帮我扫描这份 PDF，看它是否合规安全。
say.note: 返回 pass/reject 和扫描报告。

say.text: 检查这个链接是否在违规域名黑名单上。
say.note: 会解析域名并给出判定。

say.text: 扫描这个 Word 文档，并告诉我风险等级。
say.note: 返回报告中含黑名单命中与风险等级。

howto.what_en: Performs security and compliance scanning on files or URLs entering the system, outputs pass/reject verdict and a scan report, writes provenance, and acts as the mandatory first gate for all document processing.
howto.when_en: Triggers automatically as the first gate when a file or URL is submitted to the system; if the scanning service is unavailable, it rejects the file and raises an alert, never downgrading to allow.

say_en.text: Scan this PDF and check if it is compliant and safe.
Check if this link is on the blocked domain blacklist.
say_en.note: Resolves the domain and gives a verdict.

say_en.text: Scan this Word document and tell me the risk level.
say_en.note: Report includes blacklist hits and risk level.
